annotations.text:
One rule for every kind of dot: a dot is an ANSWER — a row in the fit.
Two-option and scale questions stay one dot. A choice is a row of beads, one per option. A catalogue card is a row of its popular picks (at most ten). A profile value is a bead on the You arc.
Chords are the ones the Map already draws, over rows instead of questions. Every sentence under the field is an exact count with its basis.

Three things this draft decides that are yours to change:
1 · Pictures live in the card's chips, not on the rim — a 6 px bead cannot carry a face.
2 · The You arc sits INSIDE the rim, so it never competes with the topic bands.
3 · A bead group trimmed by the budget keeps one bead and a small +n; tap opens the group.
